findings.reason: Mouse panel-to-regimen matching remains AMBIGUOUS, resolution_status OPEN, needed_at prepare. This page supports the Figure 3c panel, strain, stated MIC, PMB regimen and terminal response associations, but A65 explicitly states: No matched measured PK for these efficacy regimens. It does not verify cross-panel exposure-response joins. The supplied upstream item also records that attachment bodies have not been searched; this page-only assessment does not establish broader retrieval coverage. Mouse panels cannot be treated as matched regimen-level exposure-response records without verification.

findings.reason: AVAILABLE_CANDIDATE inputs include K. pneumoniae FADDI-KP065, individual log10 CFU/lung responses, pre-treatment and vehicle comparators, stated observation times, PMB dose fractionation and a panel-associated MIC. Inoculum, host immune status, infection-to-treatment interval, explicitly defined treatment duration, exact administration times and MIC method, medium, standard, replicates and summary definition are NOT_FOUND on this page. Only one PMB schedule is shown, so this item does not establish dose-frequency variation that separates candidate indices. Separate-PK compatibility and matched exposure inputs remain UNRESOLVED.
findings.needed_material: Authorized experimental-method and MIC-context evidence, complete administration history, any design evidence varying dose and interval, and source-supported PK-to-PD applicability and exposure links before ranking indices or estimating targets.
